استشرفن (form X)

# اُسْتُشْرِفْنَ (ustušrifna) /us.tuʃ.rif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
# اِسْتَشْرِفْنَ (istašrifna) /is.taʃ.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
